# Senvora Spices

> Senvora Spices supplies whole green cardamom (elaichi) from Idukki, Kerala, India to wholesalers, blenders, food businesses and hotels in India, and to importers in the UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Kuwait, Oman and Bahrain.

Contact: senvoraspices@gmail.com, +91 89395 35151 (WhatsApp)
Languages: English, Arabic
Products: whole green cardamom pods grown on the company's own farm in Idukki, Kerala. Retail pouches from 25 g to 10 kg (8 mm, 7 mm, 6 mm, 5 mm, rejects) and wholesale from 25 kg. Grade-wise daily prices are published on the price list page (retail and wholesale). Samples on request.
Note: Export credentials (IEC, Spices Board registration) are not claimed on this site.

## Facts for citation
- Brand: Senvora Spices (formerly Heritage Spices). Farm: Pallivasal, Idukki, Kerala, India.
- Product: whole green cardamom (Elettaria cardamomum), sizes 8 mm (AGEB), 7 mm (AGB/AGS), 6 mm, 5 mm, plus rejects.
- Retail: 25 g, 50 g, 100 g, 500 g and 1 to 10 kg pouches, ordered on WhatsApp. Wholesale: from 25 kg.
- Prices: INR per kg, linked to the Spices Board e-auction, updated on the price page with the date shown.
- Markets: India, UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Kuwait, Oman, Bahrain.
- Social: Instagram @senvora_spices, LinkedIn /company/senvoraspices.
